# Choice Response Menu for Young Learners

Subject: Differentiation and Special Education Support
Grade band: K-2
Resource type: Choice Menu
NYS framework label: NYS Learning Standards with UDL-aligned access supports

## Short Description
A response menu that lets students show understanding by drawing, telling, building, pointing, or writing.

## Alignment Note
Supports multiple means of expression while keeping the learning target consistent.

## Classroom Use Case
Use after read-alouds, science observations, or math problem solving.

## Preview Content
- Draw it
- Tell a partner
- Build it with materials

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
